entries.01fb58e8ba531ddd: Companies advancing the cloudification of core systems
entries.04cfb99ec276eb6b: A cloud solutions company that supports migrating core systems such as SAP systems to the cloud, through to operation after migration.
entries.054d40934ea81727: Companies operating core systems such as SAP systems
entries.06f63a1e125457c8: This is a single-segment business that provides services to migrate the infrastructure of corporate core systems from on-premises to the cloud, and maintenance and operation services after the cloud environment migration. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,626 million.
entries.076cd0605db6bb23: This is a service that purchases AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud licenses from each vendor and sells them to customer companies, and that handles billing on a monthly-charge basis and responds to technical inquiries.
entries.144c505bf40841a9: This is a service that monitors and operates the virtual servers and networks of systems built by customer companies in their cloud environments, performing operation and maintenance on their behalf through a remote operation system running 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. It also provides monitoring and help desk services for the SAP foundation (BASIS). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,367 million.

entries.8350de194a562195: Companies operating systems in cloud environments
entries.b3c0ae0337280ed6: This is a service that provides consulting for migrating the infrastructure of core systems centered on SAP systems from on-premises to the cloud, and the design, construction and migration of cloud infrastructure. It also undertakes conversion to SAP S/4HANA and application development. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,446 million.
entries.e85c9ba6aed1e196: This is a service that purchases AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud licenses from each vendor and sells them to customer companies, and that handles billing on a monthly-charge basis and responds to technical inquiries. It also sells licenses for other companies' products, such as security software. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,811 million.
